description:
(Summary from jobright.ai; the original posting may say more.)

Healthpeak Properties, Inc. hires Forward Deployed Software Engineers to build products and platforms that support its tenants, partners, and internal teams. The role embeds engineers with business teams to identify opportunities, rapidly develop solutions, and scale technology that improves real estate operations and customer experiences.
Forward Deployed Software Engineer building real-estate platforms and rapidly prototyping solutions for internal teams, tenants, and partners

Responsibilities:
• We exist to transform technology into a revenue-generating arm of the real estate business, building products and platforms that directly support our tenants, partners, and the teams who serve them every day
• You will work side-by-side with operators, asset managers, and customer-facing colleagues to rapidly identify opportunities, design solutions, and deliver real value
• You will relentlessly prototype, test, launch, and scale new ideas—often moving from concept to production in the matter of weeks
• Our first and most important customers are our peers inside Healthpeak, and our ultimate goal is to create delightful, seamless experiences for our tenants and partners by relentlessly minimizing friction

Requirements:
• Inquisitive engineers who care just as much about why we're building it as how it should be built
• Those who dare to reimagine how work can be done
• Proven programming expertise across languages such as Python, Java, C++, and TypeScript/JavaScript, with hands-on experience developing alongside AI agents (e.g., Claude Code)
• Backgrounds in Computer Science, Mathematics, Software Engineering, Physics, or Data Science are especially relevant
• Strong technical problem-solving skills, including practical experience with data structures, storage systems, cloud infrastructure, front-end frameworks, and related technologies
• Demonstrated ability to collaborate effectively with both technical and non-technical stakeholders, thriving in fast-paced environments with evolving goals and iterative user feedback
• Self-directed and adaptable learner, capable of working independently and making sound decisions with minimal oversight
